findings.evidence: The proof only casts `S.card_mul_index` and applies `isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left`; neither step requires commutativity.
findings.issue: `isUnit_natCard_subgroup` unnecessarily requires `CommSemiring k`; its proof uses no commutativity, so the reusable group-theory API is under-generalized.

findings.evidence: `mackeyClassFun`, `mackeyClassFun_mem_classFunction`, `ClassFunction.ind`, and `indClassFun_mackey` are declared under `[Semiring k]`; lines 97–123 use only those APIs.
findings.fix: Move these three declarations into a `[Semiring k]` section, introducing `[Field k]` only for `characterPairing_ind_ind_mackey`.
findings.issue: `mackeyClassFunction`, `mackeyClassFunction_coe`, and `comap_subtype_ind_mackey` inherit `[Field k]`, although all constituent class-function and Mackey APIs work over a semiring.

summary: Several new foundational declarations impose stronger scalar assumptions than their implementations and underlying APIs require.
